description:
Hushfacebook v0.16.1 targets Facebook 583.0.0.39.55 (com.facebook.katana), the newest release.

A quick fix for 0.16.0, which closed Facebook whenever comments opened on a lot of phones, posts opened from a notification included. Comments open normally again with Comment sheet options patched in, so there's no need to leave it out anymore. Instant games also download through Facebook itself now, since Google Play can't deliver them to a patched Facebook.

This release has 94 patches. Built by GitHub Actions from commit 3d9f759140ae, with build provenance attested. The patches weren't applied to a Facebook APK in CI.

Review diagnostic reports for private data before sharing them.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Facebook 583.0.0.39.55, build 475614366, or its 32-bit build 475614365. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
